name: AI 与技术
blurb: 让我对这个领域保持敬畏和兴奋的文章。
blurbEn: Writing that keeps me in awe of this field.

items.title: A Recipe for Training Neural Networks
items.note: Karpathy 的炼丹手册，每次训练模型前重读一遍都有收获。
items.noteEn: Karpathy's field guide to training models — I reread it before every run and still learn something.

items.title: The Bitter Lesson
items.note: Rich Sutton 的经典短文：算力 + 通用方法最终会赢过人类精心设计的先验。
items.noteEn: Rich Sutton's classic: compute plus general methods eventually beats hand-crafted human priors.

items.title: Distill — 视觉化的机器学习论文
items.note: 把论文做成可交互可视化的典范，虽然停更了但常看常新。
items.noteEn: The gold standard for interactive, visual research papers. No longer updated, but endlessly rereadable.

name: 写作与思考
blurb: 教我怎么想问题、怎么把想法写清楚的文章。
blurbEn: Pieces that taught me how to think — and how to write it down clearly.

items.title: How to Do Great Work
items.note: Paul Graham 关于如何做出色工作的长文，值得每年重读。
items.noteEn: Paul Graham on doing outstanding work — worth revisiting once a year.

items.title: The Age of the Essay
items.note: 写作不是把想好的东西写下来，写作本身就是想的过程。
items.noteEn: Writing is not transcribing finished thoughts; the writing is the thinking.

name: 有趣的角落
blurb: 互联网上让人会心一笑或大开眼界的地方。
blurbEn: Corners of the internet that make me smile or gasp.

items.title: 3Blue1Brown
items.note: 数学可视化的天花板，神经网络系列是我的入坑作。
items.noteEn: The ceiling for mathematical visualization — the neural network series is what pulled me in.

items.title: xkcd
items.noteEn: A reliable source of joy for anyone with a technical brain.
